# Color depth

@difference The depth argument of `Graphics` is ignored: the picture is always 8 bits per channel, and `Dither` and `WBuffer` do nothing.

`Graphics` and `Graphics3D` always make at least an 8-bit-per-channel R8G8B8 picture, with an A8 alpha channel where a program uses one. The depth argument is ignored, because palette and 16-bit rendering are not supported. `GraphicsDepth`, `GfxModeDepth`, `DisplayDepth` and `DisplayModeDepth` always say 32, the mode lists have each size once instead of once per depth the display could show, and `GfxModeExists` and `GfxMode3DExists` do not look at their depth argument. `Dither` and `WBuffer` do nothing: there is no 16-bit color to dither, and the depth buffer is the float one described in the depth buffer page.
